Group affiliation—racial, ethnic, or religious—amplifies this, as populations evolve distinct strengths under selective pressures. America's current pseudocracy—lip service to equality amid de facto oligarchy—exemplifies hierarchy's absence. The top 1% hoard 40% of wealth (Federal Reserve data), yet without caste, they face Bolshevik envy: cancel culture, wealth taxes, and riots. Lottery-like college admissions breed resentment when "winners" flunk out. Caste eliminates this: no false hope, just assigned fulfillment. Social order surges—Japan's implicit ethnic hierarchy yields near-zero homicide; homogeneous castes would do the same here.

Critics cry "inhumanity!" Yet caste elevates humanity by aligning with dharma—cosmic duty. Outcastes gain purpose in service, spared the despair of false ambition. Biblical precedent abounds: Leviticus mandates tribal inheritance; noblesse oblige ensured medieval serfs' welfare better than modern ghettos.

The time for half-measures is over. Congress must pass the American Caste Act: DNA-verified birthrights, group registries, endogamy laws, and caste-specific rights/duties. Penalties for evasion: expulsion or servitude. Indoctrinate via schools, rewarding loyalty to station.
